exposure: Interval between initial convulsion and delivery
Timing of medical care (within six hours of convulsion)
cohort: The study included 192 pregnant women diagnosed with eclampsia, all beyond 28 weeks of gestation, admitted to a labor ward in India.
finding: Early and appropriate medical management combined with decisive delivery planning, especially when initiated within six hours of convulsion, significantly improves fetal viability and maternal outcomes while reducing perinatal mortality.
mod_finding: The study observed a high cesarean section rate, reflecting the need for rapid stabilization and demonstrating its influence on perinatal outcomes.
birth_weight: Perinatal mortality was higher in newborns with a birth weight less than 2 kg.
gest_age: All included pregnant women were beyond 28 weeks of gestation.
